context: A boss and his manager read morning legal news with strong opinions
purpose: Teach: 検察/最高裁/警察官/制裁/疑惑/不当/警戒/衝突

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の新聞、見たか？あの汚職疑惑、ついに検察が動いたらしいぞ。
lines.en: Did you see this morning's paper? Apparently the prosecutors finally moved on that corruption suspicion.
lines.style: Gruff senior boss, clipped sentences, leans forward over his coffee with intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、私も読みました。現役の警察官まで関与しているなんて、信じられませんね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it too. I can't believe even active-duty police officers are involved.
lines.style: Polished manager tone, measured pacing, shakes head while folding the newspaper neatly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: こういうのはな、最高裁まで行ってもらわんと困る。中途半端な判決じゃ示しがつかん。
lines.en: Cases like this have to go all the way to the Supreme Court. A half-measure ruling sets a bad example.
lines.style: Old-school boss bluster, drops polite endings, jabs finger toward the article emphatically.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同感です。それに海外では既に経済制裁の話まで出ているそうですよ。
lines.en: I agree completely. On top of that, overseas they're reportedly already discussing economic sanctions.
lines.style: Diplomatic agreement, soft-spoken but informed, glances at his phone to confirm the source.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 不当な扱いを受けた被害者だって大勢いるんだ。警戒を強めるのは当然だろう。
lines.en: There are loads of victims who got unfair treatment too. Of course they're tightening their guard.
lines.style: Indignant grumble, voice rising slightly, slaps the desk for emphasis on each point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 国会でも与野党の意見の衝突が激しくなっているようですね。
lines.en: It seems the clash of opinions between ruling and opposition parties is intensifying in the Diet as well.
lines.style: Analytical observation, calm and even, adjusts glasses while summarizing the political landscape.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふん、政治家どもは口先ばかりだ。我々は仕事に戻るぞ、コーヒー飲み終わったら。
lines.en: Hmph, politicians are all talk. We're getting back to work as soon as I finish this coffee.
lines.style: Dismissive snort, abruptly pivots back to business, drains his mug with finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。九時の会議資料、机に置いておきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll leave the materials for the nine o'clock meeting on your desk.
lines.style: Crisp professional sign-off, slight bow, gathers the paper and steps away briskly.
